# CodeKrafters SRM

> CodeKrafters is the premier student tech community at SRM Institute of Science and Technology, Ramapuram (Chennai, India). We operate across 7 technical and non-technical domains, run hackathons, workshops, and real-world student developer projects.

## About Us

- `Homepage -> https://codekraftersrmp.in`: Main website — overview of the club, domains, events, and team
- `Our Team -> https://codekraftersrmp.in/team`: Meet the student leaders, domain heads, and core members
- `Events -> https://codekraftersrmp.in/events`: Upcoming and past tech events, hackathons, and workshops
- `Projects -> https://codekraftersrmp.in/projects`: Open-source projects and student developer work
- `Blog -> https://codekraftersrmp.in/blog`: Technical articles and tutorials by CodeKrafters members
- `Join Us -> https://codekraftersrmp.in/join`: Recruitment portal — apply to join the community
- `KraftersLink -> https://codekraftersrmp.in/krafterslink`: All official social media and community links

## Key Facts

- Founded: 2022
- Institution: SRM Institute of Science and Technology, Ramapuram Campus, Chennai, India
- Community size: 500+ active student developers
- Domains: Artificial Intelligence, Web Development, Cybersecurity, App Development, Design & Creatives, Content, PR & Events Management
- Contact: codekraftersrmp@gmail.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/codekrafterssrm/
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/codekrafters-srm/
- GitHub: https://github.com/CODEKRAFTERS-SRMIST

## What We Do

CodeKrafters provides SRM students with hands-on experience in real-world tech domains. Members work on live projects, compete in hackathons, create technical content, and build a strong developer portfolio before graduation. The club bridges the gap between academic learning and industry-ready skills.

## Recruitment

CodeKrafters recruits annually. Applicants choose up to 2 domains, complete a technical task, and go through an interview process. All 16 SRM departments are welcome to apply.
